resources.string: The keyboard makes a chip for each phone number in your clips. Without a format, it keeps every number that has 7 to 15 digits, and some of them are not phone numbers. Add the format of the numbers that you copy, and the keyboard keeps only those. A number matches with or without its country code, and the spaces, hyphens and brackets do not matter.
There is no format. The keyboard keeps every number.
The keyboard makes a chip for this number.
The keyboard skips this number. It matches no format.
There is no format, so the keyboard makes a chip for this number.
Type a phone number that you copy often. The keyboard makes a format from it. You can also write a format yourself: X is any digit, and a digit that you type must match.
This is not a phone number yet.
